# M.I. Engineering Works

> Manufacturer, supplier and exporter of ASTM A193 Grade B7 industrial fasteners — stud bolts, hex bolts, heavy hex bolts, threaded rods, anchor bolts, socket products and round bars — based in the Iron Market, Girgaon, Mumbai 400004, India. Serving refineries, petrochemical plants, power plants, EPC contractors and fabricators in India and export markets since 2016.

## Company facts

- Legal/trade name: M.I. Engineering Works
- Business type: Manufacturer, supplier, exporter of industrial fasteners
- Address: 301, 01, Mehar Iron Bazar, Iron Market, Khedwadi, Girgaon, Mumbai 400004, Maharashtra, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98199 72301
- Email: mienginering17@gmail.com
- GST: 27CBFPM8207D1ZR
- Quality: ISO 9001:2015 compliant manufacturing, EN 10204 3.1 material test certificates, third-party inspection (LRQA, BV, SGS, TUV) on request
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST
- Primary material: ASTM A193 Grade B7 (42CrMo4 / AISI 4140) chromium-molybdenum alloy steel; also B7M, B16, L7, L7M, B8, B8M, 8.8, 10.9, 12.9
- Standards: ASTM, ASME, DIN, ISO, BS, IS
- Size range: M6 to M100 (1/4" to 4"), lengths 30 mm to 3000 mm, custom sizes to drawing
